test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GBTMS' is written as 'HNGYT' and 'PONDEK' is written as 'PVWMLK'. How will 'VIGOUR' be written in that code language?
solution:
**Explanation :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af9cfa35a1b8810e38328421bfbd33050c32de331085ef6af8fde345c735089f.png] 

Logic : Letters are coded as opposite alphabet positional value according to above table

'GBTMS' is written as 'HNGYT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df1f78875faee4d47d2d9f982b1de2f358325cde6d6ef476465b338fcd14929.png] 

'PONDEK' is written as 'PVWMLK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab4318b06a4aa54e3b8b54dff14ae9e01e56c179b49737c99147a47bc79958ec.png] 

Similarly,

'VIGOUR' is written as 'IFLTRE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99fb0301aea7a5d2c13ff46d5405bfb0a1f2ed5a9f6f0e93bda89dfa01a1745d.png] 

Hence, **"IFLTRE"** is the correct answer.
